description: This PHP file defines a class ContentPage that extends a base ContentPage class to generate Confluence-formatted content pages. It includes functionality for embedding images, processing HTML content, and adding Confluence-specific macros.

classes.name: ContentPage
classes.description: A class responsible for generating Confluence formatted content pages, with support for embedding images and handling Confluence macros.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Generates the content of the page, embedding images and adding Confluence macros if necessary.

methods.name: createImageTag
methods.description: Creates an HTML image tag with Confluence-specific attributes based on provided attributes and filename.
